malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate packages do not typically generate random filenames for core binaries or dependencies.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Random file names may be used for temporary files, but not for persistent executables.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for Python packages that decode Base64-encoded URLs or configuration at import-time, generate random filenames for executables, and download binaries to /tmp/. Flag any package that executes downloaded binaries, especially in an infinite loop. Watch for outbound connections to known mining pool domains and the presence of mining binaries in temporary directories.
